description: Schemas, tables, columns, and sequences catalogue scenarios
comment: Table-driven pack for Schemas, tables, columns, and sequences. Shared project template; each scenario overlays one declarative file.

scenarios.description: apply create.schema with a native in-place operation
scenarios.comment: Covers PG-CAT-STC-01::create.schema. Keep public.transition_anchor identity stable.

requiredMigrationPatterns.description: creates the object with native CREATE DDL

forbiddenMigrationPatterns.description: does not replace the transition anchor
